checks.name: Single-app Clock capture
checks.observation: Selected Clock in Android's single-app picker. MediaProjection reported TYPE_SCREEN_CAPTURE. Returning BOOHTACORD displayed the expected message that Android hid the selected application; the participant thumbnail still contained a Clock frame.

checks.name: Full-display local viewer
checks.observation: Selected Entire screen. The local viewer showed a recursive portrait capture with the full screen visible and letterboxed in the landscape viewer; the participant thumbnail also showed the captured screen.

checks.name: Background and resume
checks.observation: After Home for 10 seconds, dumpsys still reported the app's TYPE_SCREEN_CAPTURE projection. Returning to BOOHTACORD preserved the non-black recursive local viewer. This run did not establish remote playback or independently prove foreground-service state throughout the background interval.

checks.name: Local sender diagnostics without a remote receiver
checks.observation: The 720p/15 FPS local capture viewer updated, but the diagnostics popover showed encoded 0 FPS and sent 0 kbit/s on two samples about eight seconds apart. No remote receiver was connected, so this cannot distinguish absent receiver demand from a sender-stats/publication defect. The displayed 6 ms screen sender RTT is not voice-dock RTT.

checks.name: Stop, leave and restore permission
checks.observation: After dismissing the diagnostics popover and tapping stop, dumpsys media_projection returned null. Leaving SHARE_TEST returned to the empty prejoin roster. The RECORD_AUDIO UID app-op was restored to its original foreground mode.

limitations: Emulator-only; physical Pixel acceptance remains open.
No paired browser/macOS receiver was present. Sender counters cannot be correlated with decoded receiver frames or the ten-second loss window.
Local full-display pixels do not prove publication, remote delivery or receiver crop.
remaining: Repeat with a separate live receiver and compare bounded sender counters with two receiver samples; verify publication, decoded pixels, crop, background state, and stop/unpublish on Android and macOS. Keep FE-52, FE-59 and FE-64 open.
